title: The derived pullback along the comparison morphism of sites
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme and $\Lambda$ a finite discrete commutative ring. Let $
u_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}	o T_{\mathrm{et}}$ be the comparison morphism from the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] to the small etale site of $T$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], and $
u_T^*:\operatorname{Mod}(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)	o\operatorname{Mod}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ its inverse image on sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules, an exact additive functor by [lem-sf-comparison-pullback-exact]. The *derived pullback*

$$
 
u_T^*:D(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)\longrightarrow D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)
$$

from the derived category of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on $T_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] to that on $T_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules] is the triangulated functor induced by applying $
u_T^*$ termwise to cochain complexes [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated]; no resolution is needed, since termwise $
u_T^*$ preserves quasi-isomorphisms. By part (3) of [lem-sf-comparison-pullback-exact] it carries the full subcategory $D^{+}(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ of complexes whose cohomology sheaves vanish below some integer into $D^{+}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$; the restricted functor $
u_T^*:D^{+}(T_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)	o D^{+}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda)$ is also written $
u_T^*$.
